verdict.en: Boss-tier ARC loot: hold a few for Energy Clips and Surge Shield Rechargers, sell the surplus at 640 each.
verdict.zh: 大型ARC的战利品：留几个做能量弹匣和爆能护盾充能器，多余的按640钱币卖掉。

use.en: Feeds Energy Clip crafting and the Surge Shield Recharger (Medical Lab 2), and Research Station blueprints such as Jolt Mine and Tactical Mk. 3 (Defensive) need it too.
use.zh: 用于制作能量弹匣和爆能护盾充能器（医疗实验室2级），研究站里的电击地雷、战术 Mk. 3（防御型）蓝图也要用到。

obtain.en: Drops from tougher ARC: Queen, Matriarch, Bombardier, Leaper, Rocketeer. Queen and Matriarch debris holds it in both main and small piles, but those only appear with their map conditions and are very dangerous.
obtain.zh: 由女王、族母、投弹手、跳跃者、火箭手等较强的ARC掉落。女王和族母的残骸大小堆里都有，但它们只在对应地图条件下出现，难度很高。

tips.en: No live project asks for it. Keep a couple for Energy Clips and Surge Shield Rechargers and sell the rest.
tips.zh: 目前没有进行中的项目需要它。留几个做能量弹匣和爆能护盾充能器，其余卖掉。

tips.en: Recycling only gives 2 ARC Powercells (270 each), far below the 640 sell price.
tips.zh: 回收只得2个ARC能量电池（各270），远低于640的售价。

verdict.en: Keep it: Gear Bench 3 and Utility Station 3 upgrades, a long list of Mk. 3 augments and Sheltered Retreat all use it.
verdict.zh: 留着：装备工作台3级、工具工作台3级升级、一大堆 Mk. 3 增强和掩护撤退都要用。

use.en: Needed for every Mk. 3 augment blueprint craft at the Gear Bench, plus Photoelectric Cloak, Power Rod and Raider Hatch Key.
use.zh: 装备工作台制作 Mk. 3 增强要用，光电斗篷、能量管、奇袭者暗门钥匙也需要。

obtain.en: Rare loot from Electrical containers, and from Queen debris. Several quests pay it out, so finish Taking Stock, Bees!, Paving the Way and Digging Up Dirt first. You can also craft it at Refiner 2 from Electrical Components and Wires.
obtain.zh: 出自电子类容器和女王残骸。清点物资、蜜蜂！、开辟道路、揭露丑闻几个任务会直接奖励，先做完。也可以在精加工机2级用电子元件和导线合成。

tips.en: Keep 5 for Gear Bench 3 and 5 more for Utility Station 3 before you sell any. Sheltered Retreat phase 2 also wants 3.
tips.zh: 装备工作台3级和工具工作台3级各要5个，先留够再卖；掩护撤退第2阶段另要3个。

tips.en: Recycling returns one Electrical Components and one Wires, worth far less than 1,750.
tips.zh: 回收只返还1个电子元件和1个导线，远不值1750。

verdict.en: The Gunsmith item: it gates the Gunsmith 3 upgrade and most weapon crafts and repairs, so keep a healthy stack.
verdict.zh: 武器工作台的核心材料：3级升级以及大部分武器制作、修理都离不开它，多留一些。

use.en: Used to craft Anvil, Bettina, Osprey, Rascal, Renegade, Torrente, Venator and others, and for the Magnetic Accelerator. Several weapon repairs also use it.
use.zh: 制作铁砧、贝蒂娜、鱼鹰、无赖、叛逆、奔流、复仇者等武器和磁力加速器都要用，部分武器修理也消耗它。

obtain.en: Dropped by Queen and Matriarch, and found in Mechanical containers such as Industrial Cleaners and Control Panels. Quests like Straight Record, A Balanced Harvest and Tribute to Toledo hand out several. Refiner 2 can craft it from Mechanical Components and Steel Springs.
obtain.zh: 女王和族母会掉落，机械类容器（工业清洁器、控制面板）里也能找到。理顺记录、丰富收获、给托雷多管理层上贡等任务奖励不少。精加工机2级可用机械元件和钢质弹簧合成。

tips.en: Gunsmith 3 needs 5; after that, keep only what weapon crafts need.
tips.zh: 武器工作台3级要5个，之后只留武器制作用得上的。

tips.en: Recycling high-tier weapons can return some, which is a cheaper route than farming bosses.
tips.zh: 回收高阶武器能返还一些，比刷首领省事。

verdict.en: A weak heal that is worth more as an ingredient: keep a few for Agave Juice, otherwise break it into seeds.
verdict.zh: 治疗效果很弱，更适合当材料：留几片做龙舌兰汁，其余拆成种子。

use.en: Heals 1 per second for 10 seconds. With In-Round Crafting, combine it with an Empty Wine Bottle to make Agave Juice.
use.zh: 每秒回复1点，持续10秒。有局内制作技能时，可与空酒瓶合成龙舌兰汁。

obtain.en: Harvest agave plants (the community wiki shows one on Dam Battlegrounds) or look in Wicker Baskets. Baskets show up on maps with Lush Blooms or Cold Snap active.
obtain.zh: 可采集龙舌兰植株（社区维基标注大坝战场有），或在柳条篮里找。柳条篮在“繁花盛开”或“寒流”条件的地图出现。

tips.en: No live project needs it, so only Agave Juice crafting is a reason to hold any.
tips.zh: 目前没有进行中的项目需要它，只有制作龙舌兰汁才值得留。

tips.en: Feeding it to Scrappy gives +5 Assorted Seeds; recycling gives 3.
tips.zh: 喂给废品仔可得5个混合种子，回收得3个。

verdict.en: Common-tier amplification key. It sells for 7,000, so only keep it if you are actually amplifying a common weapon.
verdict.zh: 普通品质武器的增强模块。售价7000，除非你真要增强普通武器，否则卖掉。

use.en: Amplification permanently rebuilds a weapon and cannot be undone; it needs the Outpost plus Gunsmith and Research Station at level 4.
use.zh: 增强会永久改造武器且不可撤销，需要解锁前哨站，并把武器工作台和研究站升到4级。

obtain.en: Scavenged from the Fallen Emperor and the ARC Frigate, both 2.0 events. The Frigate appears on every map and has no free loadout.
obtain.zh: 来自“堕落的皇帝”和ARC护卫舰，都是2.0的活动内容。护卫舰各地图都会出现，且没有免费装备。

tips.en: The wiki says it cannot be broken down, but local data shows 7 Amplified Fragments on recycling, worth 500 each. Selling at 7,000 pays double.
tips.zh: 社区维基称不可分解，但本站数据显示回收得7个增强碎片（各500）。直接卖7000更划算。

verdict.en: Unlocks Amplification for uncommon weapons. Sell it for 7,000 unless you plan to amplify one.
verdict.zh: 解锁罕见武器的增强。不打算增强就直接卖7000。

use.en: Pick the module that matches the weapon's rarity; this one is the Uncommon match.
use.zh: 模块要和武器品质对应，这一个对应罕见品质。

obtain.en: Same pool as the rest of the line: the Fallen Emperor and the ARC Frigate event.
obtain.zh: 与同系列一样，来自“堕落的皇帝”和ARC护卫舰活动。

tips.en: Recycling gives 7 Amplified Fragments, only 3,500 coins of value, and those fragments are also what repairs amplified guns.
tips.zh: 回收得7个增强碎片，仅值3500，不过增强武器的修理也靠它们。

verdict.en: The Rare-weapon module. Mid-tier guns are the best amplification candidates; otherwise sell.
verdict.zh: 稀有武器模块。中阶武器最适合增强，否则卖掉。

use.en: Matches Rare weapons. Amplified weapons gain +70 max durability but cannot be reverted.
use.zh: 对应稀有武器。增强后最大耐久+70，但不可还原。

obtain.en: Drops come from Fallen Emperor and the ARC Frigate; plan around them rather than random loot.
obtain.zh: 来自“堕落的皇帝”和ARC护卫舰，要靠打这些活动，而不是随机搜刮。

tips.en: If it ends up unused, selling is worth 7,000 against 3,500 from recycled fragments.
tips.zh: 用不上的话卖7000，回收碎片只值约3500。

verdict.en: Epic-tier module for a favorite epic weapon; spare ones are 7,000 coins each.
verdict.zh: 史诗武器的模块，用于你最爱的史诗武器；多余的每个能卖7000。

use.en: Pairs with Epic weapons. Make sure the build is one you will keep, because the change is permanent.
use.zh: 适配史诗武器。确认是自己要长期用的配装，因为改造是永久的。

obtain.en: Event loot from the Fallen Emperor and ARC Frigate.
obtain.zh: 来自“堕落的皇帝”和ARC护卫舰的活动战利品。

tips.en: The Amplified Fragments to repair these guns come only from recycling, so budget for them.
tips.zh: 这类武器的修理材料增强碎片只能靠回收获得，要提前算好。

verdict.en: Legendary-weapon module. Only worth using on a gun you will carry for ages; otherwise it is a 7,000 coin sale.
verdict.zh: 传奇武器的模块。只给会长期使用的枪用，否则就是一笔7000的买卖。

use.en: Legendary guns get +100 durability from amplification instead of +70.
use.zh: 传奇武器增强后耐久+100，普通是+70。

obtain.en: Comes from the Fallen Emperor and the ARC Frigate, the 2.0 event bosses.
obtain.zh: 来自2.0的活动首领“堕落的皇帝”和ARC护卫舰。

tips.en: Spares can be recycled for fragments, but selling pays twice as much.
tips.zh: 多余的可回收成碎片，但卖掉收益高一倍。

verdict.en: Repair currency for amplified weapons only; worthless if you do not use them, 500 coins each if you sell.
verdict.zh: 只用于修理增强武器；不用增强武器的话，每个卖500。

use.en: Spent on repairing amplified weapons. Cannot be recycled itself.
use.zh: 用于修理增强武器，本身不可回收。

obtain.en: Only obtained through recycling, such as breaking down amplified weapons or Amplification Modules (7 each).
obtain.zh: 只能通过回收获得，例如分解增强武器或增强模块（每个模块7个）。

tips.en: Stack size is 50, so keep a reserve before taking an amplified gun into a raid.
tips.zh: 一组可堆叠50个，带增强武器出击前先备一批。

tips.en: Check an amplified weapon's repair cost before buying into it; the fragments add up.
tips.zh: 增强前先看修理成本，碎片消耗会累积。

verdict.en: Keep 8 for Medical Lab 3, then hold some for Vita Spray and Sterilized Bandages.
verdict.zh: 留8个给医疗实验室3级，再留一些做补水喷雾和消毒绷带。

use.en: Goes into Sterilized Bandage, Vita Shot and Vita Spray, and the Tactical Mk. 3 (Revival) blueprint.
use.zh: 用于消毒绷带、生命针剂、补水喷雾，以及战术 Mk. 3（复苏）蓝图。

obtain.en: Look in medical containers, or take it as a quest reward: A New Type of Plant (5), After Rain Comes (3) and Home to Roost (2). Refiner 2 turns 10 Chemicals and 2 Great Mullein into one.
obtain.zh: 去医疗类容器里找，或拿任务奖励：新型植物（5）、风雨过后（3）、归巢（2）。精加工机2级可用10化学品加2大毛蕊花合成。

tips.en: The quest Doctor's Orders also takes 2.
tips.zh: 医生的订单任务还要2个。

tips.en: Recycling only returns chemicals, so crafting from them is a net loss.
tips.zh: 回收只得化学品，用化学品合成则不划算。

verdict.en: Cheap fruit with one real purpose: Scrappy upgrades. Keep 15 until levels 3 and 5 are done.
verdict.zh: 便宜的水果，真正用途是废品仔升级。留15个，直到3级和5级完成。

use.en: Restores 20 stamina. Also a Fruit Mix ingredient with Lemon and Prickly Pear.
use.zh: 回复20体力，也可与柠檬、仙人掌果合成水果拼盘。

obtain.en: Pick them under apricot trees or search Wicker Baskets. Trees drop 1 to 4 on the ground, and circling the tree can reveal more. Baskets appear with Lush Blooms or Cold Snap.
obtain.zh: 在杏树下捡，或搜柳条篮。杏树地上有1到4个，绕树可能还有额外掉落。柳条篮在“繁花盛开”或“寒流”条件下出现。

tips.en: Scrappy level 3 needs 3 and level 5 needs 12.
tips.zh: 废品仔3级要3个，5级要12个。

tips.en: Feeding one to Scrappy gives metal parts; recycling gives 3 seeds.
tips.zh: 喂给废品仔可得金属零件，回收得3个种子。

verdict.en: The workhorse ARC material: keep it for workshop upgrades, Sheltered Retreat and recipes, sell only extras.
verdict.zh: 最常用的ARC材料：留给工作台升级、掩护撤退和合成配方，只卖多余的。

use.en: Needed for Utility Station, Explosives Station and Medical Lab level 1 upgrades, and as the base material for ARC Circuitry and ARC Motion Core.
use.zh: 工具工作台、爆炸物工作台、医疗实验室1级升级要用，也是ARC线圈和ARC运动核心的原料。

obtain.en: Every ARC enemy drops it, so kill anything: Wasps, Ticks and Turrets are cheap. Surveyors and Leapers drop more kinds of materials.
obtain.zh: 所有ARC都会掉落，随便打小怪即可，黄蜂、跳蚤、炮塔最省力。

tips.en: Utility Station, Explosives Station and Medical Lab level 1 need 6 each; Sheltered Retreat phase 2 wants 10.
tips.zh: 工具工作台、爆炸物工作台、医疗实验室1级各要6个；掩护撤退第2阶段要10个。

tips.en: It only recycles into 2 Metal Parts at 200 coins, so do not recycle.
tips.zh: 回收只得2个金属零件，别回收。

verdict.en: Keep 10 for the Refiner 3 upgrade plus more for blueprints; recycle only the extras into alloy.
verdict.zh: 精加工机3级需要10个，蓝图还要更多；只回收多余的换成合金。

use.en: Required for Research Station 3 blueprints, Deadline, Medium Shield and Power Rod.
use.zh: 研究站3级蓝图、死线、中型护盾、能量管都要用。

obtain.en: Dropped by Bastion, Leaper, Rocketeer, Surveyor, Matriarch and Queen. Bastions and Leapers are the practical farm targets.
obtain.zh: 堡垒、跳跃者、火箭手、ARC勘测师、族母、女王会掉落。实际刷的话主要打堡垒和跳跃者。

tips.en: Nothing Ventured wants 6. No live project uses it, so sell or recycle surplus beyond upgrades and crafts.
tips.zh: 焉得虎子要6个。目前没有进行中的项目需要它，升级和制作之外的多余部分可卖或回收。

tips.en: Do not craft it from 8 alloy; that wastes alloy.
tips.zh: 别用8个合金去合成，亏。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for the Refiner 2 upgrade and 6 for Nothing Ventured; the rest only matters for a few gun crafts.
verdict.zh: 留5个升精加工机2级、6个给焉得虎子，其余只用于几个武器制作。

use.en: Goes into Launcher Ammo, Magnetic Accelerator and Wolfpack. Also a Vertical Grip III blueprint ingredient.
use.zh: 用于发射器弹药、磁力加速器、狼群，以及垂直握把 III蓝图。

obtain.en: Dropped by Bastion, Leaper, Rocketeer, Sentinel, Surveyor and Queen. Sentinels are the easier option.
obtain.zh: 堡垒、跳跃者、火箭手、哨卫、ARC勘测师、女王会掉落，哨卫相对好打。

tips.en: No live project needs it, so after the upgrade and quest, sell extras.
tips.zh: 目前没有进行中的项目需要它，升级和任务用完后多余的可以卖。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for the Refiner 1 upgrade and a few for shield recharging; sell the rest at 270.
verdict.zh: 留5个升精加工机1级，再留几个充护盾；其余按270卖。

use.en: Recharges 2 shield per second for 10s and is the base of Shield Recharger.
use.zh: 每秒恢复2点护盾，持续10秒，是护盾充能器的原料。

obtain.en: Every ARC enemy drops it, so Wasps, Hornets and Snitches are the cheap farm.
obtain.zh: 所有ARC都掉，打黄蜂、马蜂、告密者最轻松。

tips.en: A Prime Specimen needs 2. No live project uses it, so sell the rest.
tips.zh: 完美样本要2个。目前没有进行中的项目需要它，其余卖掉。

tips.en: It cannot be recycled, so selling is the only cash-out.
tips.zh: 无法回收，只能卖。

verdict.en: Keep one for Sizing Things Up; otherwise it is a 100 coin sale.
verdict.zh: 留1个做审时度势任务，其余卖100钱币。

use.en: One of three couplers for the Emperor Gateway Conduit.
use.zh: 是“帝王”通道导管三个耦合器之一。

obtain.en: Scavenged from a Harvester Payload after deploying an Emperor Beacon, which comes from a fallen beacon on Pendola Pass. Rocketeers are also listed as a source.
obtain.zh: 部署“帝王”信标后从收割者载荷中取得，信标来自彭多拉山口的坠落信标。火箭手也可能掉落。

tips.en: Beacon debris can hit hard, so stay clear.
tips.zh: 信标落物伤害高，注意躲开。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for Research Station 4, then use the rest for Research Points or sell at 2,000.
verdict.zh: 留3个升研究站4级，其余可用掉换研究点或卖2000。

use.en: Gives 200 Research Points when used, which pays for blueprints.
use.zh: 使用后获得200研究点，可用于解锁蓝图。

obtain.en: Scavenged from ARC machines, and cannot be crafted or recycled.
obtain.zh: 从ARC机械上搜刮，无法制作或回收。

tips.en: Station 4 also needs 3 Thermal Shakers and a Frigate Inductor.
tips.zh: 研究站4级还要3个热能摇杆和1个“护卫者”感应器。

verdict.en: Only useful for the Emperor Gateway Conduit; otherwise sell it for 100.
verdict.zh: 只用于“帝王”通道导管，不然卖100。

use.en: One of three required couplers, together with the Conductive and Plated types and the blueprint.
use.zh: 三个耦合器之一，另外还需导电、镀层两种及蓝图。

obtain.en: Comes out of a Harvester Payload after you activate an Emperor Beacon.
obtain.zh: 启用“帝王”信标后，从收割者载荷中获得。

tips.en: Only craft once you hold all three plus the blueprint.
tips.zh: 三个和蓝图凑齐再制作。

verdict.en: A one-purpose item: only the Emperor Gateway Conduit uses it, so sell it unless you are crafting that.
verdict.zh: 只有一个用途：“帝王”通道导管。不做的话卖掉。

obtain.en: Scavenged from a Harvester Payload after deploying an Emperor Beacon.
obtain.zh: 部署“帝王”信标后从收割者载荷中取得。

tips.en: Weighs little, so keeping one costs almost nothing.
tips.zh: 重量很小，留着几乎没代价。

verdict.en: Currency for Celeste: bank them, because they are light and only worth 100 coins each as junk.
verdict.zh: 给塞莱斯特换货用的货币：很轻，直接卖才100，不如攒着。

use.en: Trade seeds to Celeste: 1 buys a Metal Part, 15 buys a gun-part set, 60 buys Complex Gun Parts. Scrappy also accepts them for better materials.
use.zh: 向塞莱斯特换货：1个换金属零件，15个换武器零件，60个换复杂枪械零件。废品仔也收，可能给更好的材料。

obtain.en: Break down any Nature item, or open Fridges, Lockers, Seed Drawer Boxes and Wicker Baskets.
obtain.zh: 分解自然类物品，或搜冰箱、储物柜、种子抽屉盒、柳条篮。

tips.en: Shaker needs 7. Weight is 0.05.
tips.zh: 摇铃要7个，重量仅0.05。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for the Research Station level 1 upgrade; after that it is only a 270-coin sell item.
verdict.zh: 留5本升级研究站1级，之后只是270钱币的卖品。

obtain.en: It comes from ordinary scavenging with no known fixed spot. The Clean Hands quest also pays one out. It cannot be recycled, so extras can only be sold.
obtain.zh: 来自常规搜刮，没有已知的固定刷新点；任务“清理指针”也会奖励一本。无法回收，多余的只能卖。

tips.en: Using one directly gives 50 Research Points, but only do that once you hold the 5 the upgrade needs.
tips.zh: 直接使用可得50研究点，但要先凑够升级所需的5本。

verdict.en: A useful crafting staple: keep a stack for crafting and quests, recycle only the surplus.
verdict.zh: 常用制作材料：留一叠给制作和任务，多余的再回收。

use.en: It goes into Energy Clips, Jolt Mines and Medium Shields (4 each), plus a few for the Trash Into Treasure, Clamoring for Attention and After Rain Comes quests.
use.zh: 用于制作能量弹匣、电击地雷和中型护盾（中型护盾每个4个），任务“变废为宝”“哗众取宠”“风雨过后”也要用。

obtain.en: Open technological and electrical containers such as terminals, computers, recording panels, oscilloscopes and control consoles. Celeste sells up to 10 a day for 5 Assorted Seeds each.
obtain.zh: 搜刮终端、电脑、录音面板、示波器和控制台等科技与电子类容器。塞莱斯特每天限购10个，每个5混合种子。

tips.en: Recycling only gives 2 Metal Parts, far below the 250 coin value, so sell surplus rather than break it down.
tips.zh: 回收只得2个金属零件，远不如250钱币的价值，多余的直接卖，别拆。

verdict.en: Only worth keeping one for the Grappling Hook; otherwise sell it for 270.
verdict.zh: 只需留1个做钩爪，其余卖掉换270钱币。

obtain.en: Look in mechanical and industrial containers. You can also get one back by recycling a Grappling Hook or Tether Launcher.
obtain.zh: 在机械和工业类容器里找。回收钩爪或系索发射器也能拿回1个。

tips.en: Recycling returns just 2 Metal Parts, so selling is the better deal.
tips.zh: 回收只有2个金属零件，卖掉更划算。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Research Station level 2 upgrade, then sell extras at 640 each.
verdict.zh: 留3个升级研究站2级，多余的按640钱币卖掉。

use.en: Besides the Research Station upgrade, it is a one-off ingredient in the Advanced Camera, Mountaineer's Detector and Tether Launcher.
use.zh: 除研究站升级外，还是高级相机、登山者探测器和系索发射器的单件配料。

obtain.en: The community wiki lists Pendola Pass as the scavenging source, in technological and electrical loot. No exact containers are documented yet.
obtain.zh: 社区维基列出彭多拉山口为搜刮来源，属于科技和电子类战利品，尚无确切容器记录。

tips.en: Stack size is only 3, so plan inventory space before a Pendola Pass run.
tips.zh: 堆叠上限只有3，去彭多拉山口前留好背包空间。

verdict.en: A weak heal with no live project needing it: eat them or sell at 460.
verdict.zh: 治疗很弱，目前没有项目需要：直接吃掉，或按460钱币卖。

use.en: As food they heal only 1 per second for 10 seconds, so do not rely on them in a fight. Nothing currently being built or crafted needs them.
use.zh: 作为食物每秒只回1点，持续10秒，战斗中不要指望它。目前没有进行中的项目或配方需要它。

obtain.en: Candleberry bushes appear on Pendola Pass and on maps running the Cold Snap condition, each giving 1 to 3 berries. Wicker baskets there also hold some.
obtain.zh: 烛莓灌木出现在彭多拉山口以及“寒潮”条件的地图上，每丛1到3颗，当地的柳条篮里也有。

tips.en: Recycling gives 2 Assorted Seeds, which is poor next to the 460 coin value.
tips.zh: 回收只得2个混合种子，不如460钱币的卖价。

verdict.en: Keep a working stock for grenades and gun crafts; the rest is fine to sell at 300.
verdict.zh: 留一批做手雷和武器制作，其余可按300钱币卖掉。

use.en: It is needed for Bettina I (3), Rascal I (5), Heavy Fuze Grenades, Smoke Grenades, Shaker and Vita Spray.
use.zh: 用于制作贝蒂娜 I（3个）、无赖 I（5个）、重型引信手雷、烟雾手雷、摇铃和补水喷雾。

obtain.en: Search commercial containers. Celeste also sells 10 a day for 6 Assorted Seeds each, and Untended Garden pays 5.
obtain.zh: 搜刮商业类容器。塞莱斯特每天限售10个，每个6混合种子，任务“无人照看的农园”奖励5个。

tips.en: Recycling gives 3 Plastic Parts, so only break them down if you are short on plastic.
tips.zh: 回收得3个塑料零件，缺塑料时才拆。

verdict.en: Keep it: Explosives Station 1 needs 50, and ammo and grenades all burn through it.
verdict.zh: 别卖：爆炸物工作台1级要50个，弹药和手雷也都离不开它。

use.en: The Explosives Station level 1 upgrade needs 50, Smoke Grenades eat 14 each, and light, medium, heavy and shotgun ammo all use it. It is also the base of Crude Explosives.
use.zh: 爆炸物工作台1级需要50个，烟雾手雷每个耗14个，轻中重型和霰弹枪弹药都要用，还是粗制炸药的原料。

obtain.en: Medical, residential and mechanical containers carry it. Recycling Laboratory Reagents (16) or Impure ARC Coolant (12) is a fast way to bulk up. Celeste sells it for 1 Assorted Seed.
obtain.zh: 医疗、居住和机械类容器都有。回收实验室试剂（16个）或不纯净的ARC冷却剂（12个）能快速囤货。塞莱斯特1混合种子就卖。

tips.en: It is worth only 50 coins, so the value is all in the crafting.
tips.zh: 只值50钱币，价值全在制作上。

verdict.en: Keep every one: the Aphelion, Equalizer and Jupiter each need 3.
verdict.zh: 全部留着：远日点、制裁者、木星各需要3个。

use.en: Besides the three weapons, Research Station 3 blueprints for the Bettina and Hullcracker take 1 each, and the Complex Gun Parts blueprint itself takes 2.
use.zh: 除了这三把枪，研究站3级的贝蒂娜和裂甲者蓝图各要1个，复杂枪械零件蓝图本身要2个。

obtain.en: Kill the Queen or the Matriarch, or search security containers. Celeste sells 1 a day for 60 Assorted Seeds. Learning the blueprint lets the Refiner level 3 craft it from six gun parts.
obtain.zh: 击杀女王或族母，或搜刮安保类容器。塞莱斯特每天限售1个，60混合种子。学会蓝图后可在精加工机3级用六个枪械零件合成。

tips.en: Recycling one gives only 3 Simple Gun Parts, a bad trade for 3000 coin value.
tips.zh: 回收只得3个简易枪械零件，对不起3000钱币的价值。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for Explosives Station 2, craft more from Chemicals when you need them.
verdict.zh: 留5个升级爆炸物工作台2级，缺了用化学品自己合。

use.en: It feeds Explosive Compound, Pulse Mine, Seeker, Shrapnel and Snap Blast grenades, Launcher Ammo and the Trailblazer blueprint. Thrown directly it only does 15 damage.
use.zh: 用于炸药混合物、跳雷：冲击、追踪手雷、碎片手雷、闪爆手雷、发射器弹药和开拓者蓝图。直接投掷只有15点伤害。

obtain.en: Kill Pops and Fireballs, or search industrial and security containers. Quests Sparks Fly and Echoes of Victory Ridge pay 4 and 6.
obtain.zh: 击杀爆爆和火球，或搜刮工业与安保类容器。任务“灭蜂大计”和“凯旋岭的回声”分别奖励4个和6个。

tips.en: Six Chemicals craft one at Refiner 1, so you rarely need to hunt it.
tips.zh: 六个化学品在精加工机1级就能合成，一般不用专门找。

verdict.en: Stockpile it for weapon grips and stocks; tier III mods take 5 each.
verdict.zh: 为握把和枪托囤货，III级配件每个要5卷。

use.en: Angled and Vertical Grips and Stable Stocks scale from 1 to 5 tape per tier, and Padded and Lightweight Stocks take 5.
use.zh: 直角握把、垂直握把和稳定枪托按等级需要1到5卷，减震与轻型枪托各要5卷。

obtain.en: Search residential and commercial containers. Four quests (A Bad Feeling, Keeping the Memory, A Symbol of Unification, Source of the Contamination) pay 5 each, and Celeste sells 10 a day for 6 Assorted Seeds.
obtain.zh: 搜刮居住和商业类容器。四个任务“不祥预感”“铭记于心”“团结的象征”“污染源头”各奖励5卷，塞莱斯特每天限售10卷，每卷6混合种子。

tips.en: Recycling returns 3 Fabric, which is cheap, so keep the tape.
tips.zh: 回收只得3个布料很亏，胶带别拆。

verdict.en: Keep some: the Medical Lab 2 upgrade, bandages and Crash Mats all use it.
verdict.zh: 留一些：医疗实验室2级、绷带和缓冲垫都要用。

use.en: It is needed for Sterilized and Herbal Bandages and Crash Mats, plus the Medical Lab level 2 upgrade (5) and the Doctor's Orders quest.
use.zh: 用于消毒绷带、草药绷带和缓冲垫，另需用于医疗实验室2级（5块）和任务“医生的订单”。

obtain.en: Medical and commercial containers hold it. You can also craft one from 14 Fabric at Refiner 1, and the quests After Rain Comes and Divided pay 5 and 2.
obtain.zh: 医疗和商业类容器会出。也可用14个布料在精加工机1级合成，任务“风雨过后”和“分歧”分别奖励5块和2块。

tips.en: Recycling gives 6 Fabric from a 14 Fabric recipe, so avoid breaking it down.
tips.zh: 14个布料合成的东西回收只回6个，别拆。

verdict.en: Keep 10 for the Gear Bench and Utility Station upgrades; extra feeds Mk. 2 augments and Advanced Electrical Components.
verdict.zh: 留10个升级装备工作台和工具工作台，多余的用来做Mk. 2配件和高级电子元件。

use.en: Gear Bench 2 and Utility Station 2 take 5 each. It also goes into Mk. 2 augments, Advanced Electrical Components, Surge Coil and Jolt Mine.
use.zh: 装备工作台2级与工具工作台2级各需5个。还用于Mk. 2配件、高级电子元件、涌能线圈和电击地雷。

obtain.en: Search electrical containers, or kill Rocketeers and Vaporizers. The quests Wires Crossed, Ruins and Reverberations and Greasing Her Palms give 3 each.
obtain.zh: 搜刮电子类容器，或击杀火箭手和汽化者。任务“线路交错”“废墟和回响”“打通通路”各奖励3个。

tips.en: Crafting one costs 8 Plastic Parts and 4 Rubber Parts, but recycling returns only 3 of each, so craft rather than lose them.
tips.zh: 合成要8塑料零件和4橡胶零件，回收只回各3个，别拆。

verdict.en: Hold it: you need exactly one for Gunsmith level 4 and for Belly of the Beast.
verdict.zh: 留着：武器工作台4级和“兽腹深处”任务都要一个。

obtain.en: It is scavenged from the Fallen Emperor. The wiki gives no spawn spot, and you cannot recycle it, so treat it as a boss reward.
obtain.zh: 来自陨落帝王，维基没有给出具体刷新点，也无法回收，视作首领奖励。

tips.en: It sells for 7000, but the workshop and quest both need it, so do not sell the only copy.
tips.zh: 能卖7000，但工作台和任务都要它，唯一的一个别卖。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for the Trophy Display and a few for weapon crafts; otherwise a solid 2750 coin sale.
verdict.zh: 留5个给战利品展示架，再留几个做武器；其余可按2750钱币出手。

use.en: They are in Bobcat I, Hullcracker I, Tempest I, Vulcano I and Snap Hook, and Trophy Display phase 5 takes 5.
use.zh: 用于山猫 I、裂甲者 I、风暴 I、火山 I 和安全钩，战利品展示架第5阶段要5个。

obtain.en: Exodus containers drop them. Celeste sells 1 a day for 55 Assorted Seeds, and the quests Nothing Ventured, Celeste's Journals and Line in the Sand pay 1 to 2.
obtain.zh: 离巢类容器会出。塞莱斯特每天限售1个，55混合种子；任务“焉得虎子”“塞莱斯特的日记”“沙滩防线”奖励1到2个。

tips.en: Stack size is 3, and recycling gives 2 Magnets and 2 Processors, which is not worth it unless you need them.
tips.zh: 堆叠上限3；回收得2磁铁和2处理器，不缺就别拆。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Research Station level 3 upgrade; use or sell any extra.
verdict.zh: 留3本升级研究站3级，多余的使用或出售。

obtain.en: The wiki lists Exodus loot and Pendola Pass as sources, with no exact containers. Quest Sizing Things Up pays one.
obtain.zh: 维基列出离巢类战利品和彭多拉山口为来源，没有具体容器；任务“审时度势”奖励一本。

tips.en: Using one gives 150 Research Points, but spare the first three for the upgrade.
tips.zh: 使用可得150研究点，但前三本先留给升级。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for Explosives Station 3; the rest is a decent 1000 coin sale.
verdict.zh: 留5个升级爆炸物工作台3级，其余按1000钱币卖。

use.en: It goes into the Deadline, Wolfpack, Explosive Mine, Fireworks Box, Blaze Grenade and Heavy Fuze Grenade, and Explosives Station 3 takes 5.
use.zh: 用于死线、狼群、爆炸地雷、烟花箱、火焰手雷和重型引信手雷，爆炸物工作台3级要5个。

obtain.en: Kill a Comet or a Leaper, or search industrial and security containers. The Power Out quest pays 5. Two Crude Explosives and two Oil craft one at Refiner 2.
obtain.zh: 击杀彗星或跳跃者，或搜刮工业与安保类容器。任务“电力不足”奖励5个。两个粗制炸药加两份油可在精加工机2级合成。

tips.en: Recycling yields 2 Crude Explosives, so it is cheaper to keep or sell than to break down.
tips.zh: 回收只得2个粗制炸药，不如留着或卖掉。

verdict.en: Never sell: Gear Bench 1 and Medical Lab 1 take 80 between them, and bandages use it.
verdict.zh: 别卖：装备工作台1级和医疗实验室1级共要80个，绷带也用它。

use.en: It makes Bandages (5), Durable Cloth (14) and White Flags (10). It also restores 0.4 health per second for 25 seconds when used on its own.
use.zh: 用于制作绷带（5）、耐磨布料（14）和白旗（10）。单独使用每秒回0.4点生命，持续25秒。

obtain.en: Commercial, medical and residential containers. Recycling Duct Tape (3) or ARC Thermo Lining (16) gives lots, and Celeste sells it for 1 Assorted Seed.
obtain.zh: 商业、医疗和居住类容器都有。回收胶带（3）或ARC隔热衬里（16）可大量获得，塞莱斯特1混合种子就卖。

tips.en: Worth just 50 coins, so spend your carry space on better loot once your upgrades are done.
tips.zh: 只值50钱币，升级完成后背包空间留给更好的战利品。

verdict.en: No live project or recipe uses it: sell it, 1000 coins for a nature drop.
verdict.zh: 目前没有项目或配方需要它，直接卖掉，一份值1000钱币。

obtain.en: It spawns in garden beds, such as the greenhouses in the Village on The Blue Gate and the hydroponic domes on Dam Battlegrounds. Wicker baskets also hold some.
obtain.zh: 刷新在花圃里，如蓝门的村庄温室和大坝战场的水培穹顶，柳条篮里也有。

tips.en: Recycling gives only 2 Assorted Seeds, so sell it unless you need seeds for Celeste.
tips.zh: 回收只得2个混合种子，不缺种子换塞莱斯特的东西就直接卖。

verdict.en: A new 2.0 Amplified weapon material with unclear sources; keep it until recipes are confirmed.
verdict.zh: 2.0新增的强化武器材料，来源尚不明，配方确认前先留着。

use.en: The game describes it as crafting material for Amplified weapons. No recipe, project or quest uses it yet, and it cannot be recycled.
use.zh: 游戏描述为强化武器制作材料。目前还没有配方、项目或任务使用它，也无法回收。

obtain.en: The community wiki lists only generic scavenging and its page is still a stub, so no spawn location is confirmed.
obtain.zh: 社区维基只写了常规搜刮，页面仍是草稿，尚无确认的刷新点。

tips.en: It sells for 5000, so if you never find a use, selling is a safe fallback.
tips.zh: 能卖5000钱币，最终用不上卖掉也不亏。

verdict.en: Sell or recycle it: it has no quest use, and recycling gives Explosive Compound.
verdict.zh: 卖掉或回收：没有任何任务用途，回收可得炸药混合物。

obtain.en: It is found at the epicenter of lightning strikes on maps with the Electromagnetic Storm condition. Nature loot can also hold it.
obtain.zh: 出现在“电磁风暴”条件的地图上，闪电落点的中心，自然类战利品里也可能有。

tips.en: Recycling gives 3 Explosive Compound (1000 each), the same as the 4000 coin sale or better. Your Explosives Station 3 upgrade needs 5 compound.
tips.zh: 回收得3份炸药混合物（每份1000），与4000钱币卖价相当甚至更好；爆炸物工作台3级正好要5份。

verdict.en: Use it for 1000 Research Points or sell it for 3000; it has no other purpose.
verdict.zh: 可用来换1000研究点，或卖3000钱币，没有别的用途。

obtain.en: It is found in the trail left behind by a Frigate. The wiki gives no map or spawn point, and it cannot be recycled.
obtain.zh: 掉在“护卫者”留下的轨迹上。维基没有给出地图或刷新点，也无法回收。

tips.en: Use it if you need the Research Station upgrades; otherwise take the coins, since nothing needs it.
tips.zh: 研究站升级缺研究点就用掉，否则没有项目需要它，直接卖钱。

verdict.en: Keep exactly one: it is the single gate to Research Station level 4, and it sells for a lot if you never get there.
verdict.zh: 只留一个：它是研究站 4 级的唯一门槛，用不上再卖。

obtain.en: It comes from scavenging the ARC Frigate, so you need to bring one down and loot it. Nothing else is known to drop it. The wiki gives no map or area, so treat any specific spot claims with suspicion.
obtain.zh: 来自拆解“ARC护卫者”，需要先击落并搜刮。目前没有其他来源，社区也没给出具体地图或区域。

tips.en: Research Station levels also need a matching Outpost level, so the inductor is wasted if you pick it up long before you are ready.
tips.zh: 研究站升级还要求哨站等级达标，太早拿到也派不上用场。

tips.en: Recycling gives Advanced ARC Powercells and ARC Circuitry; only do that once level 4 is done.
tips.zh: 回收可得高级ARC能量电池和ARC线圈，等研究站升到 4 级后再考虑。

verdict.en: A cheap herb worth a few copies for Antiseptic and Herbal Bandages; do not stockpile it.
verdict.zh: 便宜的草药，留几株做防腐剂和草药绷带即可，无需囤。

use.en: Antiseptic takes 2 and an Herbal Bandage takes 1, so a handful covers several crafts. One quest, Doctor's Orders, also asks for one.
use.zh: 防腐剂要 2 株，草药绷带要 1 株，几株就够做好几次。任务“医生的订单”也要 1 株。

obtain.en: Harvest the plants in nature areas or open Wicker Baskets and backpacks. Celeste also sells it for 5 Assorted Seeds, 10 per day, which is the easy route if you have seeds to burn.
obtain.zh: 在自然区域采摘植株，或开柳条篮和背包。塞莱斯特也以 5 个混合种子出售，每日限购 10 个，有闲置种子时最省事。

tips.en: Once you have what Antiseptic needs, recycle extras into Assorted Seeds (2 each).
tips.zh: 够做防腐剂之后，多余的回收成混合种子（每株 2 个）。

verdict.en: Keep three if you want the Anvil I; otherwise it is only worth its 640 coin sale price.
verdict.zh: 想做“铁砧 I”就留 3 个，否则只能按 640 钱币卖。

use.en: Its only crafting use is Anvil I, which needs three. Recycling returns a single Mechanical Component, which is poor.
use.zh: 唯一的制作用途是“铁砧 I”（需要 3 个）。回收只得 1 个机械元件，不划算。

obtain.en: New in 2.0. It spawns in Mechanical and Industrial type containers; the wiki names no specific map or area yet.
obtain.zh: 2.0 新增物品。出现在机械类和工业类容器中，目前没有具体地图或区域的记录。

tips.en: Do not recycle one before you decide on the Anvil, since salvage only gives 2 Metal Parts.
tips.zh: 没决定要不要做“铁砧”之前别回收，拆解只得 2 个金属零件。

verdict.en: The bottleneck for heavy weapon crafts: keep about 3 per gun you plan to build, then sell the rest.
verdict.zh: 重型武器制作的瓶颈：每把计划造的枪留约 3 个，其余卖掉。

use.en: Anvil I, Bettina I, Hullcracker I, Rascal I and Vulcano I each take 3 at tier one, and Complex Gun Parts takes 2. Several quests also hand them out, so check rewards before buying.
use.zh: “铁砧 I”“贝蒂娜 I”“裂甲者 I”“无赖 I”“火山 I”一阶都要 3 个，复杂枪械零件要 2 个。不少任务会送，购买前先看看奖励。

obtain.en: Kill Rocketeers (the wiki also lists Bombardier) and loot the Security and Raider type containers. Celeste sells 3 a day for 15 Assorted Seeds each, a decent seed sink. Quests like Nothing Ventured and Untended Garden give 3 each.
obtain.zh: 击杀“火箭手”（社区资料还列有“投弹手”），并搜刮安保类和奇袭者类容器。塞莱斯特每天限购 3 个，每个 15 混合种子。任务“焉得虎子”“无人照看的农园”各送 3 个。

tips.en: Recycling only gives 2 Simple Gun Parts, while crafting one costs 4. Never recycle if you can sell for 700.
tips.zh: 回收只得 2 个简易枪械零件，而制作一个要 4 个，不如直接卖 700。

verdict.en: Pure loot: no recipe or upgrade uses it, so sell it for 2000 unless you need the Steel Springs.
verdict.zh: 纯战利品：没有配方或升级用它，直接卖 2000，除非你缺钢质弹簧。

obtain.en: A 2.0 find in Mechanical and Industrial containers. No community post names a better area yet.
obtain.zh: 2.0 新增，出现在机械类和工业类容器。目前没有人总结出更好的刷取地点。

tips.en: Recycling gives 2 Mechanical Components and 2 Steel Springs, which feed Mod Components, so it is useful if you craft those.
tips.zh: 回收得 2 个机械元件和 2 个钢质弹簧，可用来做改装零件。

verdict.en: Grab a few for the Scrappy level 3 upgrade, then treat it as a 640 coin sell item.
verdict.zh: 拿几个给“废品仔”3 级升级，之后当作 640 钱币的出售品。

use.en: Scrappy level 3 needs 3 Lemons. Scrappy can also eat one as a feed boost, which gives Chemicals. Eating it yourself only restores a little stamina.
use.zh: “废品仔”3 级升级需要 3 个柠檬。也可以喂给废品仔换取化学品加成。自己吃只恢复少量耐力。

obtain.en: Walk around lemon trees (small trees with a thick green crown) and pick up the fruit below them, 1 to 4 per tree. Wicker Baskets also hold some. If no prompt shows, circle the tree.
obtain.zh: 绕着柠檬树（树冠浓密的小树）走，捡树下的果实，每棵 1 至 4 个。柳条篮里也有。看不到提示时绕树转一圈。

tips.en: Recycling gives 3 Assorted Seeds, which beats the 2 you get from salvage.
tips.zh: 回收得 3 个混合种子，多于拆解的 2 个。

verdict.en: Only the Bobcat needs it, so keep a few for that and sell the rest at 700.
verdict.zh: 只有“山猫”会用到，留几个就够，其余卖 700。

use.en: Bobcat I needs 3, and Complex Gun Parts needs 2. The wiki also lists higher tiers of Bobcat, Burletta and Stiletto for repair or upgrade.
use.zh: “山猫 I”需要 3 个，复杂枪械零件需要 2 个。社区资料还提到更高阶的“山猫”“布尔莱塔”“细剑”会用到。

obtain.en: Loot Raider and Security type containers. Celeste sells 3 a day for 15 Assorted Seeds each.
obtain.zh: 搜刮奇袭者类和安保类容器。塞莱斯特每天限购 3 个，每个 15 混合种子。

tips.en: Recycling returns 2 Simple Gun Parts for something that costs 4 to craft, so don't recycle it.
tips.zh: 制作要 4 个简易枪械零件，回收只返还 2 个，不要回收。

verdict.en: Keep around 10 while you work through Venator, Canto and Mk. 2 augments; they are cheap to rebuy from Celeste.
verdict.zh: 在做“复仇者”“颂歌”和 Mk. 2 增幅器期间留约 10 个，塞莱斯特处买很便宜。

use.en: Canto I and Venator I take 5 each. Combat, Looting and Tactical Mk. 2 take 3 each. No live project needs it, so stock only what those crafts use.
use.zh: “颂歌 I”和“复仇者 I”各要 5 个，战斗、搜刮、战术 Mk. 2 各要 3 个。目前没有项目需要它，按这些制作所需留够即可。

obtain.en: Look in Exodus type containers; the wiki names no specific map. Celeste sells 10 a day for 6 seeds each. Quests such as Keeping the Memory and Tribute to Toledo pay 5 each.
obtain.zh: 出现在 离巢类容器，社区没给具体地图。塞莱斯特每天限购 10 个，每个 6 种子。任务“铭记于心”和“给托雷多管理层上贡”各送 5 个。

tips.en: At 300 coins it is a poor sale, and recycling gives only 2 Metal Parts.
tips.zh: 只值 300 钱币，回收也只得 2 个金属零件，卖了不划算。

verdict.en: Do not sell it: Gunsmith level 4, many top weapons and several repairs all eat these.
verdict.zh: 别卖：武器工作台 4 级、多把高阶武器和部分维修都要用它。

use.en: Gunsmith 4 needs 3. Aphelion, Dolabra, Equalizer and Jupiter each take 3 to craft, and the wiki says repairing them takes 2. Trophy Display phase 4 wants 10.
use.zh: 武器工作台 4 级要 3 个。“远日点”“錾斧”“制裁者”“木星”制作各要 3 个，社区资料称维修要 2 个。战利品展示架第 4 阶段要 10 个。

obtain.en: Kill the Matriarch or The Queen. It also shows up in Exodus type containers, and the Refiner level 3 can craft it from 2 Advanced Mechanical Components and 2 ARC Motion Cores. The Line in the Sand quest gives 2.
obtain.zh: 击杀“族母”或“女王”。离巢类容器也会出，精加工机 3 级可用 2 个高级机械元件和 2 个ARC运动核心制作。任务“沙滩防线”送 2 个。

tips.en: Crafting one from components gets you back only half on recycling, so never recycle it for parts.
tips.zh: 回收只能返还一半材料，别为了拿零件去回收。

verdict.en: The workhorse of weapon crafts: keep a stack of 20 or more instead of selling at 640.
verdict.zh: 制作武器的主力材料：留 20 个以上，别按 640 卖掉。

use.en: Gunsmith level 2 needs 5, mods like Extended Barrel II and Silencer I need 2 to 3, and many weapon tiers need 3 to 6. Mod Components also eat them.
use.zh: 武器工作台 2 级要 5 个，加长枪管 II、消音器 I 等配件要 2 至 3 个，多款武器一阶要 3 至 6 个，改装零件也要用。

obtain.en: Kill Leapers, Bastions, Bombardiers and Shredders, or open Mechanical type containers. Three quests (A Wrench in the Works, Industrial Espionage, Water Troubles) give some. You can also refine them: 7 Metal Parts and 3 Rubber Parts at Refiner 1.
obtain.zh: 击杀“跳跃者”“堡垒”“投弹手”“粉碎者”，或开机械类容器。任务“暗中破坏”“工业间谍”“水源问题”也送。精加工机 1 级可用 7 个金属零件和 3 个橡胶零件合成。

tips.en: If you have spare Metal Parts, crafting is a fair backup when drops run dry.
tips.zh: 金属零件有富余时，合成是掉落不足时的备选。

verdict.en: Keep a few for rifle crafts; do not recycle, since crafting one costs twice what recycling returns.
verdict.zh: 为步枪制作留几个；别回收，合成一个的成本是回收所得的两倍。

use.en: Canto I, Osprey I, Renegade I, Tempest I, Torrente I and Venator I each take 3, and Complex Gun Parts takes 2. Four quests also ask for them.
use.zh: “颂歌 I”“鱼鹰 I”“叛逆 I”“风暴 I”“奔流 I”“复仇者 I”各要 3 个，复杂枪械零件要 2 个，还有四个任务需要。

obtain.en: Kill Bastions and Sentinels, and loot Raider and Security type containers. Celeste sells 3 per day for 15 seeds each, and quests like Straight Record and Flickering Threat pay 5.
obtain.zh: 击杀“堡垒”和“哨卫”，搜刮奇袭者类和安保类容器。塞莱斯特每天限购 3 个，每个 15 种子，任务“理顺记录”“初露端倪的威胁”各送 5 个。

tips.en: Stacks hold 5 and weigh 0.4 each, so don't hoard beyond what your planned guns need.
tips.zh: 单组最多 5 个且每个重 0.4，别超出计划武器所需太多。

verdict.en: Never sell or break these: Gunsmith 1 and Refiner 1 upgrades need piles, and weapon crafts and ammo keep using them.
verdict.zh: 别卖也别浪费：武器工作台、精加工机升级要一大堆，武器和弹药制作也一直在用。

use.en: Gunsmith 1 needs 20 and Refiner 1 needs 60. Weapon mods and ammo use 3 to 6 each, Mechanical Components 7.
use.zh: 武器工作台 1 级要 20 个，精加工机 1 级要 60 个。配件和弹药各用 3 至 6 个，机械元件要 7 个。

obtain.en: Open Metal Crates, car hoods and server racks; the wiki lists Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical and Technological areas. Dismantling magnets and Mechanical Components gives some back. Celeste sells it for seeds.
obtain.zh: 开金属箱、车头盖和服务器机架，社区资料列出机械、工业、电气和科技类区域。拆磁铁和机械元件也能得到一些。塞莱斯特也用种子出售。

tips.en: The wiki says Metal Parts cannot be recycled, and at 75 coins a stack of 50 is weak money.
tips.zh: 社区资料称金属零件无法回收，单价 75，一组 50 个也卖不了多少钱。

verdict.en: Keep them for tier III mods; at 1750 they are decent coin only if you skip Gunsmith 3.
verdict.zh: 留着做三阶配件；不做武器工作台 3 级配件时 1750 一个才值得卖。

use.en: Every tier III mod blueprint takes 2, plus 5 Duct Tape, 8 Wires or 5 Steel Springs depending on the mod. A few quests and the Trophy Display project want them too.
use.zh: 所有三阶配件都要 2 个，另加 5 个胶带、8 条导线或 5 个钢质弹簧。部分任务和战利品展示架也需要。

obtain.en: Found in Security type containers; no named map yet. You can also refine them from 2 Mechanical Components and 2 Steel Springs. A Wrench in the Works pays 3.
obtain.zh: 出现在安保类容器，暂无具体地图。也可用 2 个机械元件和 2 个钢质弹簧合成。任务“暗中破坏”送 3 个。

tips.en: Recycling gives back only half of the crafting cost, so craft or keep instead.
tips.zh: 回收只返还制作成本的一半，要么合成要么留着。

verdict.en: One piece is enough for a Defibrillator; no live project needs it, so recycle the rest for seeds.
verdict.zh: 做一个复苏剂只要 1 个，目前没有项目需要它，其余回收成种子。

use.en: A Defibrillator takes 1 Moss and 9 Plastic Parts. It heals 1 per second for 10 seconds, which is weak.
use.zh: 复苏剂需要 1 个苔藓加 9 个塑料零件。治疗效果每秒 1 点持续 10 秒，很弱。

obtain.en: Harvest dead trees and Hydroponic Domes (the Hydroponic Dome Complex on Dam Battlegrounds has plenty). Wicker Baskets also hold it. Celeste sells 5 a day for 10 seeds each.
obtain.zh: 采集枯树和水培穹顶（大坝战场的水培穹顶综合体较多），柳条篮里也有。塞莱斯特每天限购 5 个，每个 10 种子。

tips.en: Recycling gives 3 Assorted Seeds each, so surplus Moss is a seed source.
tips.zh: 回收每个得 3 个混合种子，多余的苔藓可以换种子。

verdict.en: Stockpile 12 for the Scrappy level 5 upgrade; at 1000 coins it is also a nice sell.
verdict.zh: 为“废品仔”5 级升级囤 12 个；单价 1000，卖也不错。

use.en: Scrappy level 5 needs 12. Feeding one to Scrappy gives Plastic Parts. It heals 15 health, but you will not use it for that.
use.zh: “废品仔”5 级要 12 个。喂给废品仔可得塑料零件。可回复 15 点生命，但没必要这么用。

obtain.en: On Dam Battlegrounds try Water Treatment Control, the Hydroponic Dome Complex, the Central Swamp Lift and the wreckage near Baron Husk. On The Spaceport, the East Container Yard has a tree with three guaranteed. Riven Tides: Dried Riverbed trees. Wicker Baskets too.
obtain.zh: 大坝战场：水处理控制中心、水培穹顶综合体、中央沼泽暗门、“男爵外壳”附近残骸。太空港：东侧集装箱堆场有一棵必出 3 个的树。裂潮镇：干涸河床的树上。柳条篮也有。

tips.en: It cannot be recycled or salvaged, so selling is the only way to cash out.
tips.zh: 无法回收或拆解，想变现只能出售。

verdict.en: Cheap and easy to rebuy: keep a few for Renegade I and Explosive Compound, sell or recycle the rest.
verdict.zh: 便宜又好买：留几个做叛逆 I 和炸药混合物，其余卖掉或回收。

use.en: Renegade I takes 5. Explosive Compound and Blaze Grenade take 2 each, and Power Out pays 5. No live project needs it.
use.zh: “叛逆 I”要 5 个，炸药混合物和火焰手雷各要 2 个，任务“电力不足”送 5 个。目前没有项目需要它。

obtain.en: Mechanical type containers. Motors recycle into the most Oil per item, and Celeste sells 10 a day at 6 seeds each, which is the easy way to stock up.
obtain.zh: 机械类容器。电机回收出的油最多，塞莱斯特每天限购 10 个，每个 6 种子，是囤货的捷径。

tips.en: At 300 coins it sells poorly; recycling into 3 Chemicals is often the better move.
tips.zh: 仅值 300 钱币，回收成 3 个化学品往往更划算。

verdict.en: Pick six for the Scrappy level 4 upgrade; every extra sells for 640.
verdict.zh: 为“废品仔”4 级升级采 6 个，多余的按 640 卖。

use.en: Scrappy level 4 needs 6 Olives and 6 Prickly Pears. Feeding one to Scrappy gives Fabric.
use.zh: “废品仔”4 级升级要 6 个橄榄和 6 个仙人掌果。喂给废品仔可得布料。

obtain.en: Head to the Olive Grove on The Blue Gate and check the ground under each tree for 1 to 4 olives. Look for a small white circle when you are close. Wicker Baskets also hold some.
obtain.zh: 去蓝门的橄榄树林，查看每棵树下的 1 至 4 个橄榄。靠近时会出现白色小圆圈。柳条篮里也有。

tips.en: Unused ones recycle into 2 Assorted Seeds each.
tips.zh: 用不上的回收后每个得 2 个混合种子。

verdict.en: Needed in bulk for Research Station level 1, so buy them with spare seeds rather than hunt.
verdict.zh: 研究站 1 级要大量木板，用多余种子买比到处找更省事。

use.en: Research Station level 1 takes 35 Planks. They are also needed for Outpost furniture and a Sheltered Retreat phase, and 5 plus 500 Research Points makes a White Flag blueprint.
use.zh: 研究站 1 级要 35 块木板。哨站家具和“掩护撤退”某阶段也要，5 块加 500 研究点数可得白旗蓝图。

obtain.en: New in 2.0. Sources are scavenging and Celeste, who sells them for 3 Assorted Seeds each. No community post names an area yet, so buying is the sure way.
obtain.zh: 2.0 新增。来源是搜刮和塞莱斯特（每块 3 混合种子）。社区还没总结出具体区域，买最稳妥。

tips.en: The wiki says Planks cannot be recycled, and at 100 coins they sell poorly.
tips.zh: 社区资料称木板无法回收，单价 100，卖不了几个钱。

verdict.en: Keep a big stack; Gear Bench 1, Utility Station 1 and many crafts want dozens.
verdict.zh: 多囤一些：装备工作台1级、工具工作台1级和很多制作都要几十个。

use.en: Gear Bench 1 needs 25 and Utility Station 1 needs 50. Tier I mods use 6 apiece, and Defibrillator 9 and Electrical Components 8.
use.zh: 装备工作台 1 级要 25 个，工具工作台 1 级要 50 个。一阶配件各要 6 个，复苏剂要 9 个，电子元件要 8 个。

obtain.en: Open Industrial drawers and server racks, and check Commercial, Residential and Technological areas. Celeste sells it for seeds, and dismantling cooling fans or recorders yields 10 to 14 each.
obtain.zh: 开工业抽屉和服务器机架，搜刮商业、居住和科技类区域。塞莱斯特用种子出售，拆冷却风扇、录音机等可得 10 至 14 个。

tips.en: The wiki says it cannot be recycled, and it only sells for 60 coins.
tips.zh: 社区资料称无法回收，单价只有 60。

verdict.en: A 2.0 Amplified weapon material worth 5000; hold it only if you are building one of those guns.
verdict.zh: 2.0 新增的强化武器材料，值 5000；只有在造强化武器时才留。

use.en: Used to craft Amplified weapons. The local data lists no recycle output and no workshop or quest uses.
use.zh: 用于制作强化武器。本站数据里没有回收产物，也没有工作台或任务需求。

obtain.en: The community wiki has no page for it yet, so the exact drop spots are not documented. Check back after more raids are reported.
obtain.zh: 社区维基尚无词条，具体掉落点没有记录，等玩家实测之后再补充。

tips.en: If you are not planning an Amplified build, it sells for a very good price.
tips.zh: 不打算做强化武器的话，卖价相当可观。

verdict.en: Keep one for Tribute to Toledo and the gear it crafts; sell extras for 5000.
verdict.zh: 留一个给“给托雷多管理层上贡”和相关装备，多余的卖 5000。

use.en: Heavy Shield takes 1, Powered Descender 1, and Snap Hook 2. Tribute to Toledo needs one. The wiki also says one opens a door in the Power Generation Complex on Dam Battlegrounds.
use.zh: 重型护盾要 1 个，动力下降器 1 个，安全钩 2 个，任务“给托雷多管理层上贡”需要 1 个。社区资料还称它可打开大坝战场发电厂综合体的一扇门。

obtain.en: Look in Exodus type containers (no specific map yet). Refiner 3 can craft it from 2 Advanced Electrical Components and 2 ARC Circuitry, and the Groundbreaking quest rewards one.
obtain.zh: 出现在 离巢类容器（暂无具体地图）。精加工机 3 级可用 2 个高级电子元件和 2 个ARC线圈合成，任务“突破性进展”送 1 个。

tips.en: Recycling returns only half the crafting cost, so selling beats recycling.
tips.zh: 回收只返还制作成本的一半，卖比回收划算。

verdict.en: An Epic Amplification ingredient worth 5,000 coins: hold it for Amplified crafts, and sell only if you have no use.
verdict.zh: 价值 5000 的史诗级增幅材料：留着做增幅武器，用不上再卖。

obtain.en: A guide names Emperor Payloads dropped during the Redirection condition on Pendola Pass as an important source. Treat that as a lead, not a guarantee; nothing confirms a drop rate.
obtain.zh: 有攻略称彭多拉山口“航向重定向”期间的“帝王”载荷是重要来源，但未见掉率数据，仅作参考。

tips.en: It stacks to only 3, so a full carry slot of them is worth a lot; put them in your Safe Pocket if you find any.
tips.zh: 堆叠上限只有 3，但价值极高，捡到后优先放进安全口袋。

verdict.en: Keep 6 for the Scrappy level 4 upgrade; after that it is a decent 640-coin sell.
verdict.zh: 留 6 个给废品仔 4 级升级，之后可以卖 640 一个。

use.en: Eating one gives a small stamina boost. It is also an ingredient of Fruit Mix, together with a Lemon and an Apricot.
use.zh: 吃掉可小幅恢复耐力，也是“水果拼盘”的原料之一，需配合柠檬和杏子。

obtain.en: Check the base of cacti in Nature zones (1-3 pears each) and Wicker Baskets. Guides point to Marano Park in Buried City, the north and the area near Pattern House on Dam Battlegrounds, and Spaceport edges. Lush Blooms makes baskets more reliable.
obtain.zh: 在自然区域的仙人掌根部找（每株 1–3 个），或搜柳条篮。攻略多提到掩埋废城的马拉诺公园、大坝战场北部和壁画屋附近、太空港边缘；“收获季节”期间柳条篮更稳。

tips.en: Put the pears in your Safe Pocket: nature items have no found-in-raid limit, so you can hand them to Scrappy later.
tips.zh: 放进安全口袋即可，自然类物品没有“带出才算”的限制，回去再交给废品仔。

tips.en: Recycling only returns Assorted Seeds, so selling beats recycling.
tips.zh: 回收只能得到混合种子，直接卖更划算。

verdict.en: Keep at least 3 for any Mk. 3 augment you plan to craft, and sell or buy the rest by need.
verdict.zh: 想做 Mk. 3 增幅就至少留 3 个，多余的按需出售。

use.en: Every Mk. 3 augment (Combat, Looting, Tactical) costs 3 Processors plus Advanced Electrical Components. The Trigger 'Nade also takes one.
use.zh: 所有 Mk. 3 增幅（战斗、搜刮、战术）都要 3 个处理器和高级电子元件，触发式手雷也要 1 个。

obtain.en: Loot Server Racks, Recording Panels, Oscilloscopes and Computers in Technological areas. A May guide also suggests Stella Montis lockboxes in the Assembly Workshop and Medical Research. Celeste sells 5 a day for seeds.
obtain.zh: 在科技类区域搜刮服务器机架、录音面板、示波器和电脑。有攻略建议去星辰山组装厂车间和医学研究部的箱柜。塞莱斯特每天限售 5 个。

tips.en: Recycling returns only Plastic Parts and Wires, far below its 500 value, so never recycle it.
tips.zh: 回收只得塑料零件和导线，远不如 500 的售价，别回收。

verdict.en: Epic Amplification material worth 5,000 coins; keep it for Amplified weapon crafts.
verdict.zh: 价值 5000 的史诗级增幅材料，留着做增幅武器。

obtain.en: I could not find a confirmed source. It is likely tied to the same Pendola Pass content as the Pressure Regulator, but no guide says so yet, so check the in-game item page.
obtain.zh: 暂未找到可靠来源。可能与压力调节器同属彭多拉山口内容，但尚无攻略证实，请以游戏内信息为准。

tips.en: New in 2.0 and stacks to 3; do not sell before you know what your Amplified crafts need.
tips.zh: 2.0 新增，堆叠上限 3；先弄清增幅制作的需求再考虑出售。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Gunsmith level 4 upgrade; every extra is a 3,000-coin sale.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个给武器工作台 4 级，多余的每个能卖 3000。

obtain.en: The wiki only says it is scavenged in Mechanical and Industrial areas, and no guide gives a container or map. Search machinery-heavy industrial spots and treat any find as valuable.
obtain.zh: 维基只说在机械与工业类区域搜刮得到，暂无具体地图或容器信息。多搜机械设备密集的工业区。

tips.en: Gunsmith 4 also needs an Emperor Modulator from the Fallen Emperor on Pendola Pass, so the Press alone will not finish the upgrade.
tips.zh: 武器工作台 4 级还需要彭多拉山口陨落帝王里的帝王调制器，只凑齐径向压力机还不够。

tips.en: Recycling gives one Advanced Mechanical Components, which is worth much less than selling.
tips.zh: 回收只得 1 个高级机械元件，远不如直接卖。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Research Station level 2 upgrade; after that it is a plain 640-coin sale.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个给研究站 2 级升级，之后当 640 的杂物卖掉。

use.en: Besides the upgrade, using one gives Research Points, which pay for blueprint crafts at the Research Station.
use.zh: 除了升级，使用一本还能获得研究点数，用于研究站解锁蓝图。

obtain.en: The wiki lists it as scavenged in Raider areas only. I found no map-specific spawn, so loot Raider-type camps and containers as you pass.
obtain.zh: 维基只标注在奇袭者类区域搜刮得到，未见具体地图刷新点，路过奇袭者据点顺手搜即可。

tips.en: New in 2.0, so spawn data is thin; recheck after more players report spots.
tips.zh: 2.0 新物品，来源信息还很少，之后可再核对。

verdict.en: Sell it: at 1,000 coins it is one of the best-paying common pickups.
verdict.zh: 直接卖：一个 1000，是最划算的常见拾取物之一。

use.en: It heals about 1 HP per second for 10 seconds, which is weak. Its real value is the sale price, and the wiki notes extra value during Lush Blooms and Cold Snap.
use.zh: 每秒回 1 点生命、持续 10 秒，效果很弱，价值主要在卖钱；维基提到在“收获季节”和“寒潮”条件下更值钱。

obtain.en: Open Wicker Baskets in Nature areas. Nothing more specific is documented.
obtain.zh: 在自然区域搜柳条篮，暂无更具体的位置信息。

tips.en: It cannot be recycled, so selling is the only conversion.
tips.zh: 无法回收，只能卖。

verdict.en: No live project or upgrade needs it; sell for 640 each.
verdict.zh: 目前没有进行中的项目或升级要它，按 640 一个卖掉。

obtain.en: Dig them at the base of certain trees in Nature areas, or find them in Wicker Baskets. The wiki does not name the trees or maps.
obtain.zh: 在自然区域特定树木根部采集，或搜柳条篮；维基未说明具体树木与地图。

tips.en: Despite the flavor text, the 640 value is not tiny. Recycling returns one seed only, so sell.
tips.zh: 介绍里说“值几个钱”，但实际有 640。回收只得 1 颗种子，直接卖。

verdict.en: Keep a few for Grappling Hook or Yank Grenade crafts; otherwise it is a cheap 300-coin item.
verdict.zh: 留几根做钩爪或系索弹，其余只值 300。

use.en: Grappling Hook takes 2 Ropes and Yank Grenade takes 1. The Grappling Hook blueprint itself also costs 10 Ropes at the Research Station.
use.zh: 钩爪要 2 根绳子，系索弹要 1 根；钩爪蓝图本身还需要在研究站交 10 根。

obtain.en: Search Residential and Commercial areas. Celeste sells 5 a day, and recycling spent grappling gear also returns some.
obtain.zh: 搜住宅与商业类区域；塞莱斯特每天限售 5 根，回收用过的钩爪类装备也会返还。

verdict.en: Keep 30 for the Gunsmith 1 upgrade; it also feeds many crafts and repairs.
verdict.zh: 留 30 个给武器工作台 1 级，也用于大量制作和修理。

obtain.en: Search Mechanical, Industrial and Electrical areas. Rubber Parts cannot be recycled, but items like Ruined Accordion, Rubber Pad and ARC Flex Rubber recycle into a lot of them. Celeste sells them for 1 seed each.
obtain.zh: 搜机械、工业、电气类区域。橡胶零件本身无法回收，但“损毁的手风琴”“橡胶垫”“ARC弹性橡胶”等回收后能出很多；塞莱斯特 1 颗种子一个。

tips.en: Repairs use 1 to 6 per item, so keep a buffer for gear upkeep too.
tips.zh: 修理装备每次也要消耗 1–6 个，留一点存货。

verdict.en: Hold a few: they feed traps and the Raider Hatch Key; no live project needs them.
verdict.zh: 留几个：用于地雷、手雷和奇袭者暗门钥匙；目前没有项目需要。

use.en: The Raider Hatch Key takes 3. Explosive Mine, Surge Coil and Tagging Grenade take 1 each.
use.zh: 奇袭者暗门钥匙要 3 个；爆炸地雷、涌能线圈、标记手雷各要 1 个。

obtain.en: Kill Snitches and Spotters, or loot Server Racks and Android drops. A farming guide recommends the metal cabinets in the Assembly Workshop and Medical Research on Stella Montis; Pilgrim's Peak on Blue Gate has many cabinets but heavy ARC patrols.
obtain.zh: 击杀告密者与侦察员，或搜服务器机架。有攻略推荐星辰山组装厂车间和医学研究部的金属柜；蓝门朝圣峰柜子多，但 ARC 巡逻很猛。

tips.en: Celeste sells 5 a day; buying beats risky farming if you are short.
tips.zh: 塞莱斯特每天卖 5 个，缺口小时买比冒险刷更省。

verdict.en: Keep 5 for the Sheltered Retreat project, then more if you build Outpost furniture.
verdict.zh: 留 5 个给“掩护撤退”项目，建哨站家具还需要更多。

obtain.en: Scavenge it or buy it from Celeste for 3 seeds. The wiki gives no spawn spots.
obtain.zh: 搜刮得到，或向塞莱斯特花 3 颗种子购买；维基没有具体刷新点。

tips.en: It cannot be recycled, and at 100 coins it is not worth selling while you are building the Outpost.
tips.zh: 无法回收，且只值 100，建哨站期间别卖。

verdict.en: Keep a stock for weapon crafts and repairs; only surplus is worth selling at 330.
verdict.zh: 留一批做武器和修理，多出来的再按 330 卖。

use.en: It goes into most tier I weapon crafts (4 to 6 each) and into Light, Medium and Heavy Gun Parts refining. Repairs also use it.
use.zh: 大多数 I 级武器制作要 4–6 个，也用于精炼轻、中、重型枪械零件，修理同样要用。

obtain.en: Kill Hornets and Turrets, or loot Raider and Security areas. Celeste sells 5 a day.
obtain.zh: 击杀马蜂和炮塔，或搜奇袭者与安保类区域；塞莱斯特每天限售 5 个。

verdict.en: Keep 4 if you want a Photoelectric Cloak; sell the extras.
verdict.zh: 想做光电斗篷就留 4 个，多的卖掉。

use.en: Photoelectric Cloak takes 4. Lure Grenade and Noisemaker take 1 each.
use.zh: 光电斗篷要 4 个，诱捕手雷和发声器各要 1 个。

obtain.en: Search Commercial points of interest. Space Travel in Buried City is a commonly named spot; Plaza Rosa and Galleria are other candidates. Headphones recycle into one.
obtain.zh: 搜商业类地点，常被点名的是掩埋废城的航天大楼，其他还有罗莎广场和购物廊。回收耳机也能得到 1 个。

verdict.en: Keep some for magazine mods and Torrente; no live project needs it.
verdict.zh: 留一些给扩容弹匣和“奔流”；目前没有项目需要。

obtain.en: Check Metal Crates and shelves in Industrial areas. Guides name the Power Generation Complex basement, Water Treatment, and Hydroponic Dome Complex shelves. A Bad Feeling and other quests also reward some.
obtain.zh: 搜工业区的金属箱和货架。攻略提到发电厂综合体地下、水处理设施和水培穹顶综合体货架；“不祥预感”等任务也有奖励。

tips.en: Recycling gives just 2 Metal Parts, so do not break them down.
tips.zh: 回收仅得 2 个金属零件，不要拆。

verdict.en: Never sell or waste them: they are the only way to apply stencils to weapons.
verdict.zh: 别卖：它们是给武器上贴花的唯一材料。

use.en: Each application costs 2 to 15 parts depending on stencil rarity, based on tooltips reported by players.
use.zh: 每次上贴花消耗 2–15 个，取决于贴花稀有度（玩家报告的数据）。

obtain.en: They drop at random in Commercial, Residential and Industrial areas. No guide names a best map or guaranteed container, and the Reward Pass also gives some.
obtain.zh: 在商业、住宅、工业区域随机掉落，没有公认的最佳地图或固定容器；奖励通行证也有。

tips.en: The skin travels with the gun, so a looted weapon takes your stencil with it.
tips.zh: 贴花跟着枪走，枪被人捡走，贴花也就没了。

verdict.en: Keep 3 for the Explosives Station level 2 upgrade, then sell for 700 or keep one for a Trailblazer.
verdict.zh: 留 3 个给爆炸物工作台 2 级，之后可卖 700 或留 1 个做开拓者。

obtain.en: Loot Exodus-tagged points of interest. Rocket Assembly on The Spaceport is the one most guides name, and recycling Rocket Thrusters returns 2. Celeste sells 5 a day.
obtain.zh: 搜带“离巢”标记的地点，攻略最常提到太空港的火箭组装区；回收火箭推进器可得 2 个。塞莱斯特每天限售 5 个。

tips.en: It explodes if shot, so do not stand next to a stack when fighting.
tips.zh: 被击中会爆炸，交火时别站在旁边。

verdict.en: Keep 1 for the Doctor's Orders quest and a few for Vita Shot; recycle or sell the rest.
verdict.zh: 留 1 个交“医生的订单”，再留几个做生命针剂，其余回收或卖。

obtain.en: Search Medical areas. Recycling Rusted Shut Medical Kits gives 2 each, and Vita Shots give 1. Celeste sells 5 a day.
obtain.zh: 搜医疗类区域；回收锈蚀封死的医疗箱可得 2 个，生命针剂 1 个。塞莱斯特每天限售 5 个。

tips.en: Recycling returns 3 Plastic Parts and 2 Chemicals, which can beat the 500 sale when you need crafting stock.
tips.zh: 回收得 3 个塑料零件和 2 个化学品，缺材料时比卖 500 更有用。

verdict.en: A throwable that is worth 270 coins; sell it, there is no other use.
verdict.zh: 能扔的石头，值 270，除了卖没有别的用处。

obtain.en: Pick it up from rocky ground on The Blue Gate. It is tagged Nature.
obtain.zh: 在蓝门的岩石地面上捡取，归类为自然。

tips.en: It cannot be recycled, and its 10 throwing damage is not worth a slot.
tips.zh: 无法回收，投掷伤害只有 10，不值得占格子。

verdict.en: Keep a few for Heavy Shield (2 per craft); sell the rest.
verdict.zh: 留几个给重型护盾（每次用 2 个），其余卖掉。

obtain.en: Search Electrical areas. Guides suggest Pilgrim's Peak on The Blue Gate, the Power Generation Complex on Dam Battlegrounds, and the Arrival Building on The Spaceport. Celeste sells 5 a day.
obtain.zh: 搜电气类区域。攻略推荐蓝门朝圣峰、大坝战场发电厂综合体和太空港到达大楼；塞莱斯特每天限售 5 个。

verdict.en: Hoard it: attachments, quests and other crafts all want it.
verdict.zh: 一定要囤：配件、任务和其他制作都要。

use.en: Silencers, muzzle brakes, compensators, chokes and extended barrels all use it, up to 8 at tier III.
use.zh: 消音器、枪口制退器、补偿器、收束器和加长枪管都要用，III 级最多 8 个。

obtain.en: Loot Server Racks, Power Distribution Boxes, Oscilloscopes, Heaters and Generator Fuse Boxes in Electrical and Technological areas. Celeste sells 10 a day.
obtain.zh: 在电气和科技类区域搜服务器机架、配电箱、示波器、加热器和发电机保险丝盒。塞莱斯特每天限售 10 个。

tips.en: Do not recycle Wires; it only returns 2 Rubber Parts.
tips.zh: 不要回收导线，只能换 2 个橡胶零件。
